promptText: Act as a malware reverse engineering engineer. Write a Ghidra Python script to run in headless mode that iterates through all functions in a target executable, identifies xrefs to hardcoded string constants, and exports them to CSV.

title: Anchoring Bias & Cognitive Framing in SaaS Tier Layouts
description: Explores how price anchoring heuristics guide user perception and drive mid-tier plan selection.
promptText: Act as a pricing strategist and behavioral researcher. Explain cognitive anchoring bias and demonstrate how placing a high-priced enterprise tier adjacent to a target plan shifts user perception of value in software pricing tables.

title: Python Scapy Custom Protocol Dissector & Analyzer
description: Defines custom network protocol headers and packet fields in Python using Scapy binary parsing.
promptText: Act as a network protocol reverse engineer. Write a Python script using Scapy that defines a custom binary network protocol header with magic bytes, command flags, and payload lengths, and parses incoming raw PCAP byte streams.

title: C++ CPU Cache-Line Optimization & Memory Layout
description: Optimizes C++ data structure layouts to prevent cache misses, false sharing, and memory padding overhead.
promptText: Act as a low-level systems performance engineer. Explain CPU cache lines (L1/L2/L3), cache-miss penalties, and struct alignment padding in C++. Refactor an inefficient array of structures (AoS) into a cache-friendly structure of arrays (SoA).

title: Social Proof Psychology: Authentic Trust vs Dark Patterns
description: Contrasts fake urgency popups with legitimate social proof techniques to build ethical, long-term user trust.
promptText: Act as a trust-centered product designer. Differentiate between deceptive social proof (fake recent-purchase popups) and ethical social proof triggers (verified metrics, transparent testimonials), analyzing their psychological impact on brand trust.

title: Android Kotlin Room Database with SQLite FTS4/FTS5
description: Builds high-performance offline full-text search capabilities in Android Kotlin using Room and SQLite FTS.
promptText: Act as a senior Android developer. Write a Kotlin Jetpack Room database implementation using SQLite Full-Text Search (FTS4/FTS5) entities and DAOs to execute millisecond-level offline keyword searches over thousands of local records.

title: C Language Double-Free Memory Corruption Analysis
description: Examines glibc heap glibc chunk management, double-free pointer corruption, and defensive coding patterns.
promptText: Act as a vulnerability analysis specialist. Explain how invoking `free()` twice on the same memory pointer corrupts internal heap metadata in glibc, and provide safe pointer sanitization wrappers (`SAFE_FREE`) in pure C.

title: The Halo Effect in UI Design & Visual Polish
description: Applies cognitive halo effect bias to justify how visual polish and typography elevate software perceived security.
promptText: Act as a visual UX researcher. Explain the psychological 'Halo Effect' in software interfaces—how high-quality typography, micro-spacing, and crisp iconography subconsciously lead users to perceive an app as faster, safer, and more reliable.

title: Python Asyncio HTTP Reverse Proxy & Traffic Interceptor
description: Constructs a lightweight asynchronous HTTP proxy in Python to inspect and modify request/response headers.
promptText: Act as a web security researcher. Write a lightweight asynchronous reverse proxy script in Python using `aiohttp` or `tornado` that inspects, logs, and modifies HTTP headers and JSON bodies on the fly for local API debugging.

title: C++ SIMD AVX2 Vectorization for Array Processing
description: Leverages Intel AVX2 intrinsics in C++ to process 256-bit vector operations for massive array acceleration.
promptText: Act as a high-performance C++ optimization expert. Write a C++ function comparing a standard `for` loop float array multiplication against an AVX2 SIMD vectorized implementation using Intel intrinsics (`_mm256_mul_ps`), detailing hardware speedups.

title: Peak-End Rule Application in Software Workflows
description: Applies Kahneman's Peak-End Rule to optimize user task completions and cancellation offboarding flows.
promptText: Act as a behavioral designer. Describe the Peak-End Rule in human memory recall. Explain how optimizing key completion moments and designing graceful offboarding experiences leave positive lasting psychological impressions on users.

title: Linux Kernel Module (LKM) Syscall Table Hooking Audit
description: Explores Linux Kernel Module architecture, system call table overwriting, and kernel integrity verification.
promptText: Act as a Linux kernel security defender. Explain how Loadable Kernel Modules (LKMs) historically manipulated system call tables (`sys_call_table`) for process hiding, and outline modern kernel protection mechanisms like KPTI and module signing.

title: Python Capstone Disassembly Engine Binary Analyzer
description: Disassembles raw binary byte streams across x86, ARM, and MIPS architectures using Python and Capstone.
promptText: Act as a binary analysis software developer. Write a Python script using the `capstone` engine that accepts hex-encoded machine code, disassembles it into ARM64 instructions, and extracts instruction mnemonics and operands.

title: The Zeigarnik Effect in Task Progress & Checklist UX
description: Utilizes incomplete task tension (Zeigarnik Effect) to boost onboarding checklist completion rates.
promptText: Act as a product gamification specialist. Explain the Zeigarnik Effect (how incomplete tasks create mental tension) and show how progress bars, incomplete profile checklists, and multi-step forms drive user engagement.

title: Solidity Oracle Manipulation & Flash Loan Attack Guard
description: Analyzes Web3 decentralized finance price oracle manipulation vulnerabilities and TWAP security fixes.
promptText: Act as a DeFi smart contract auditor. Explain how attackers use flash loans to manipulate spot-price AMM oracles in single transactions, and provide a Solidity code example utilizing Uniswap V3 Time-Weighted Average Price (TWAP) oracles.

title: C++ Curiously Recurring Template Pattern (CRTP)
description: Eliminates virtual function table dispatch overhead in C++ using CRTP static polymorphism.
promptText: Act as an advanced C++ software architect. Explain the Curiously Recurring Template Pattern (CRTP) in C++. Provide a code example demonstrating how CRTP achieves static compile-time polymorphism without the vtable memory and performance cost.

title: Overcoming Status Quo Bias in Tech Product Adoption
description: Analyzes user resistance to interface updates and provides cognitive strategies for smooth tool migrations.
promptText: Act as a change management and UX psychologist. Analyze why users resist software updates due to Status Quo Bias and habit disruption, and outline UX strategies to minimize cognitive resistance during major UI redesigns.

title: Python Unicorn CPU Emulator Binary Hooking Script
description: Emulates isolated x86/ARM machine code execution and hooks register states using Python and Unicorn Engine.
promptText: Act as an automated malware analysis engineer. Write a Python script using the `unicorn` CPU emulation engine to setup CPU memory, load raw x86 assembly code, set initial registers (EAX, EBX), and emulate execution step-by-step.

title: Android Hardware-Backed KeyStore Cryptography
description: Generates and stores AES encryption keys inside Android TEE / StrongBox hardware using Kotlin.
promptText: Act as an Android security architect. Provide a Kotlin class demonstrating how to generate secure AES-256 keys inside the Android KeyStore system (TEE/StrongBox) and perform secure payload encryption without exposing raw key bytes.

title: Foot-in-the-Door Technique in User Onboarding Funnels
description: Applies micro-commitment psychological techniques to increase signup conversion rates in complex web tools.
promptText: Act as a behavioral conversion rate strategist. Describe the 'Foot-in-the-Door' persuasion technique and design a multi-step user onboarding flow that asks for micro-commitments before requesting account registration.

title: C Uninitialized Stack & Heap Memory Data Disclosure
description: Explains memory exposure flaws caused by missing byte zeroing (`memset`/`calloc`) in Linux system code.
promptText: Act as a secure C developer. Explain how returning uninitialized stack/heap structures across user-kernel boundaries leads to sensitive memory leaks, and demonstrate how to sanitize data buffers using `memset_s` or `calloc`.

title: C++ std::filesystem Directory Traversal Sanitizer
description: Prevents path traversal attacks (`../`) in cross-platform C++ file utilities using `std::filesystem`.
promptText: Act as a secure C++ application developer. Write a C++17 function using `std::filesystem::canonical` and `std::filesystem::weakly_canonical` to safely resolve file paths and sanitize against malicious path traversal (`../`) attacks.

title: Spatial Cognition & Mental Models in App Navigation
description: Aligns digital navigation structures with cognitive spatial mapping models for intuitive user orientation.
promptText: Act as a cognitive ergonomic designer. Explain how human spatial cognitive maps apply to software navigation, and provide design rules for breadcrumbs, sidebar persistent states, and deep linking to maintain visual orientation.

title: Python Scapy Active ARP Poisoning & Spoofing Detector
description: Monitors ARP table broadcast mappings in Python to detect middle-man network attacks on local subnets.
promptText: Act as a network security analyst. Write a Python script using Scapy that listens for ARP responses, tracks IP-to-MAC mapping consistency, and raises immediate security alerts when ARP spoofing or poisoning is detected.

title: Android Kotlin WorkManager Reliable Background Sync
description: Schedules persistent, battery-optimized background tasks using Jetpack WorkManager and network constraints.
promptText: Act as an Android Kotlin developer. Write a `CoroutineWorker` implementation using Jetpack WorkManager that executes background data syncing only when the device is connected to unmetered Wi-Fi and charging.

title: Social Validation & Status Mechanics in Developer Communities
description: Analyzes status-seeking psychology, contributor leaderboards, and achievement badge mechanics in developer hubs.
promptText: Act as a community gamification architect. Explain how intrinsic motivation and social status drive contribution in open-source developer communities, and design a balanced achievement badge and reputation points system.

title: C++ Compile-Time String Encryption via Constexpr XOR
description: Obfuscates sensitive string literals in C++ binaries at compile-time using `constexpr` templates.
promptText: Act as a reverse engineering protection engineer. Write a C++20 header-only template utility that encrypts string literals using XOR at compile time with `constexpr`, leaving zero plain-text string constants in compiled binary strings.
